answer: Each new agent must bind a unique, non-exportable device certificate and lock 2,400 units for 30 days; a second seat from the same chip is refused until the lock ends. An honest operator buys one module and parks 2,400 units, later spending that pearl of working capital in ordinary trade. To field 80 sock puppets an attacker must source 80 separate certificates and immobilize 192,000 units for the full window, cash that cannot be recycled mid-lock. Cheap cloud signups may sprawl like a tundra, but a prism of software clones still collapses to one physical key.
